name: How long does a premises liability case take to resolve?
description: Case resolution time varies, from a few months for simple settlements to over a year for complex cases that go to trial.

mainEntity.name: How long does a premises liability case take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a premises liability case varies significantly depending on its complexity, the severity of your injuries, the willingness of the parties to negotiate, and court schedules if a lawsuit is filed. Simple cases might settle in a few months, while more complex cases, especially those going to trial, could take a year or more. Your attorney can provide a more specific timeline based on the details of your situation.
